title: Steel Mill Production Mix LP
description: Classic AMPL linear program maximizing weekly steel mill profit across product lines subject to rolling-mill capacity and market demand bounds.

title: Hitchcock Transportation Network LP
description: Minimum-cost freight distribution model balancing supply across manufacturing plants and demand at regional distribution centers.

title: Capacitated Facility Location MILP
description: Mixed-integer linear program selecting which regional warehouses to open and how to assign customer demand to minimize fixed opening and shipping costs.

title: Markowitz Mean-Variance Portfolio QP
description: Convex quadratic program allocating capital across asset classes to minimize portfolio variance while achieving a target expected return.

title: Security-Constrained DC-OPF with Parametric Sweep Script
description: Multi-bus DC Optimal Power Flow model minimizing generation dispatch cost subject to nodal power balance, line thermal limits, and a .run sweep script.
